text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Make Tokai Teio witness Twin Turbo's 
victory in the All Comers. The greatest 
hurdle of this plan was—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not about whether hijacking the 
broadcast succeeds or fails; it's about 
winning. Can she shake off the pursuit of 
the "Black Assassin," Rice Shower?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo undergoes special training with 
Ikuno Dictus. She masters the "Two-Stage 
Variable Front-Running" style, conserving 
energy until mid-race and exploding in the 
home stretch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Will Twin Turbo be able to seize victory 
for Tokai Teio's sake?
